_README: Tree crowns read off the LandsD vegetation mesh (VEGETATION(TB), the same flight as the model; SOURCES.md 5ag) by present_3d.py veg_trees: position, height above the 2020 ground and crown width measured; the low-poly form a stand-in. base = the model terrain's height there. kind: wood (in the fung shui wood), tree (standing alone; form camphor, longan or chinaberry in turn), ficus (the rest of the closed canopy; d widened, d_measured kept), shrub; species by present_3d.py species(), analogue.
source: LandsD 3D Visualisation Map (Individualised models), CSDI landsd_rcd_1671676915450_88604 (SOURCES.md 5ag, S43)
survey: photographed between mid-2021 and February 2024: read off the model's own ground photo (SOURCES.md 5ag); LandsD gives no date
